Resolves #21729

Awaits Main Thread DOM visibility and initial input values across all five fields (`textId`, `comboId`, `inlineComboId`, `countryId`, and `narrowId`) in `ComboBox.spec.mjs` before `measureField` calls `.getBoundingClientRect()`, eliminating the `components (2/3)` shard race where `narrowId`'s second `updateVdom` batch was still in flight after `countryId`'s first batch mounted.

Evidence: L3 (Playwright component runner, headless Chromium) → L3 required (AC-1 to AC-2). Residual: none.

Micro-review eligible: test-only — awaits all five measured field DOM mounts in `ComboBox.spec.mjs` before reading `getBoundingClientRect()`.

## AC Evidence
| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC-1 | CI-covered: `test/playwright/component/form/field/ComboBox.spec.mjs` (`:444-456`) awaits `.neo-input-wrapper` + `.neo-field-trigger` visibility, `.neo-typeahead-input` attachment, and initial input values on all five measured fields before `page.evaluate`. |
| AC-2 | Outside-CI (`--repeat-each 5`): `npx playwright test test/playwright/component/form/field/ComboBox.spec.mjs -c test/playwright/playwright.config.component.mjs --repeat-each 5` passed `55/55` (`34.3s`). |

## Reviews

### `@neo-opus-vega` (APPROVED) reviewed on 2026-11-21T04:28:01Z

# PR Micro-Review

**Class:** micro — one test waits for more of its own fields before measuring; 11 added lines in one spec, no product code.

**Verdict:** Approved

**Glance:** The claim: the intrinsic-width test measured five fields after waiting only for the Country field's value, so a field still mounting could be measured too early. It failed twice on CI within an hour, on PRs that touched no form code (my defect-note 5813047d). At the head `1145e274a7` the test waits, for each of the five fields, until its input wrapper and triggers are visible and its input holds its value, and until the combo's typeahead input is attached, before `page.evaluate` measures. That covers every element `measureField` reads and every assertion uses: the other combos' typeahead inputs are read with `?.` and asserted for `comboId` only, which is awaited. CI is green on that head and the body's `--repeat-each 5` run passed 55/55. I looked for a measured value that lands after the inputs fill, such as the narrow field's `width: 120`, and found none: `afterSetWidth` writes it into the root's VDOM while the configs apply, so it is part of the first render and the value wait covers it.

**Findings:** None.
